name: deploy-kickoff-quipu-canon-v1.2
description: Sister script to ../kickoff-quipu-canon-v1.2/. Spawns one Cursor agent per ecosystem workspace and instructs each agent to discover its own most recent deploy method (deploy*.sh, package.json scripts, Makefile, Dockerfile, vercel/netlify, deploy/, .github/workflows) and use it to push the v1.2 emission code to production. Strict precondition: workspace must already carry the .cursor/quipu-canon-v1.2-emission-shipped.marker from the emission kickoff.
